checks.message: RC20-011 must run after RC20-010 completed, with current_task set to RC20-011.
RC20-011 must consume the RC20 authority contract.
RC20 release bundle must be complete, non-GA, and internally coherent.
RC19 offline/local channel package and consumption evidence must be bound, local-only, and remote-effect-free.
RC20 release bundle must carry the same offline/local channel identity that RC20-011 promotes.
RC19 consumer smoke must carry local consumer readiness without production readiness or new effects.
Candidate channel package identity must be deterministic from source hashes and stable identity material.
Stable channel promotion must remain local projection evidence and must not publish externally or mutate active/production state.
RC20-011 must not publish, download, sign, execute install/update/rollback, upload support, execute recovery, dispatch remote work, or mutate host/production state.
Missing, stale, broad, remote, signer, host-mutating, active-artifact, production, and GA promotion attempts must fail closed.
RC20-011 outputs must not contain key blocks, private authority paths, auth tokens, or signing key file names.
